mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_dispatch_log (order_id, runner_user_id, score, dispatch_round, dispatch_type, status, is_read, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{runnerUserId}, #{score}, #{dispatchRound}, #{dispatchType}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_dispatch_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY dispatch_round ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE order_dispatch_log SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
